name: Oxilofrine
summary: Oxilofrine, sold under the brand names Carnigen and Suprifen among others, is a sympathomimetic medication which has been used as an antihypotensive agent and cough suppressant. It is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: Oxilofrine is described as an ephedrine-like indirectly acting sympathomimetic and antihypotensive agent. It acts as a norepinephrine releasing agent and indirectly activates the α- and β-adrenergic receptors. The drug has positive inotropic effects (increases myocardial contractility).
pharmacology.kind: Antihypotensive agent; Cough suppressant; Norepinephrine releasing agent; Alpha-adrenergic receptor agonist

uses.text: Oxilofrine, sold under the brand names Carnigen and Suprifen among others, is a sympathomimetic medication which has been used as an antihypotensive agent and cough suppressant. It is mostly no longer marketed today.
